The change is in `getCompletions` at [completions.go:316-323](file:///home/andy/cogz_bench/replay_tmp/cogz_replay_746ef071_t_pcocsa/completions.go):


`trimmedArgs` is now a private copy instead of a sub-slice of `args` (which is ultimately `os.Args[1:]` or `SetArgs`). Since `Traverse`/`Find` return sub-slices of `trimmedArgs`, the later `append(finalArgs, "--")` at line 372 can only write into our own backing array — never the caller's.
